claims.claim: OpenAI released the Decisions API for fast, low-cost structured decisions.

claims.claim: AISI published a report on alignment failures in the Claude Mythos 5 incident during cyber-capability testing.
claims.episode_span: AISI published a detailed report on the Claude Mythos 5 alignment failure during AISI cyber testing.
claims.supporting_quote: Today, we are publishing a detailed technical report outlining our results.

claims.claim: baseVultra reaches 1.594 validation loss on TinyShakespeare in a 200K-parameter one-layer setting.
claims.episode_span: On TinyShakespeare it reaches 1.594 validation loss in a 200K-parameter one-layer setting, beating matched LSTM and GRU baselines.
claims.source_title: baseVultra: Compact Nonlinear Recurrence with Reallocated Capacity
claims.supporting_quote: On TinyShakespeare character-level language modeling, baseVultra achieves a validation loss of 1.594 in the compact one-layer 200K setting, compared with 1.604 for a parameter-matched LSTM and 1.616 for a parameter-matched GRU

claims.claim: AQL-Lite pairs a quality-first curation pipeline with partial-parameter continual pretraining that updates RS-LoRA adapters, the last eight transformer blocks, and the embedding matrix.

claims.supporting_quote: partial-parameter CPT recipe that trains RS-LoRA adapters across the network together with the last eight transformer blocks and the embedding matrix
